1.w: And Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you⁺ look at one another?”

2.w: And he said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy for us from there, and we shall live and not die.”

3.w: And ten brothers of Joseph went down to buy grain from Egypt.

4.w: And Jacob did not send Benjamin, brother of Joseph, with his brothers, for he said, “Lest harm befall him.”

5.w: And the sons of Israel came to buy in the midst the ones coming, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

6.w: And Joseph—he was the ruler over the land; he was the one selling to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came, and they bowed themselves before him, noses to the earth.

7.w: And Joseph saw his brothers and he recognized them, and he made himself strange to them, and spoke to them harshly. And he said to them, “From where have you⁺ come?” And they said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

8.w: And Joseph recognized his brothers, and they did not recognize him.

9.w: And Joseph remembered the dreams that he had dreamed about them, and he said to them, “You⁺ [are] spies! You⁺ have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

10.w: And they said to him, “No, my lord, and your servants have come to buy food.

11.w: We [are] all sons of one man. We [are] honest; your servants are not spies.”

12.w: And he said to them, “No! But rather, you⁺ have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

13.w: And they said, “Two [and] ten [are] your servants, we [are] brothers, sons of one man in the land of Canaan. And behold, the youngest [is] with our father today, and the one [is] no more.”

14.w: And Joseph said to them, “It [is] that which I spoke to you⁺, saying, You⁺ [are] spies!

15.w: By this you⁺ shall be tested: By the life of Pharaoh, you⁺ shall not go forth from this, except if your youngest brother comes here.

16.w: Send one of you⁺ and let him bring your⁺ brother, and you⁺ shall be confined, and your⁺ words shall be tested, whether truth [is] with you⁺. And if not, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you⁺ [are] spies.”

17.w: And he put them all together in custody three days.

18.w: And Joseph said to them on the third day, “Do this and you will live; I fear God:

19.w: If you⁺ [are] honest, let one of your⁺ brothers be confined in the house of your⁺ custody, and you⁺ go and carry grain for the famine of your⁺ houses.

20.w: And you⁺ shall bring your⁺ youngest brother to me, and your⁺ words will be verified, and you⁺ shall not die.” And they did so.

21.w: And they said each man to his brother, “Truly we [are] guilty concerning our brother, for we saw the distress of his soul when he pleaded with us, and we did not listen. Upon thus, this distress has come upon us.”

22.w: And Reuben answered them, saying, “Did I not speak to you⁺, saying, ‘Do not sin against the boy’? and you⁺ did not listen! And also, his blood, behold, it is required.”

23.w: And they did not know that Joseph was listening, for the interpreter was between them.

24.w: And he turned himself away from them and wept, and he returned to them and spoke to them, and he took from them Simeon and bound him before their eyes.

25.w: And Joseph commanded, and they filled their vessels with grain, and to return their silver, each man to his sack, and to give to them provisions for the journey. And he did so. For them

26.w: and they lifted the grain upon their donkeys and departed from there.

27.w: And the one opened his sack to give feed to his donkey at the lodging place, and he saw his silver, and behold, it [was] in the mouth of his bag.

28.w: And he said to his brothers, “My silver has been returned, and also, behold, it is in my bag.” And their hearts went out, and they trembled, saying each man to his brother, “What [is] this God has done to us?”

29.w: And they came to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan, and they told him all that had happened to them, saying,

30.w: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke to us harshly and treated us as spies of the land.

31.w: And we said to him, ‘We [are] honest; we are not spies.

32.w: We [are] two [and] ten brothers, sons of our father. The one [is] no more, and the youngest [is] this day with our father in the land of Canaan.’

33.w: And the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you⁺ [are] honest: Your⁺ one brother leave with me, and take [food] [for] the famine of your⁺ houses and go.

34.w: And bring your⁺ youngest brother to me, and I shall know that you⁺ [are] not spies, but [that] you⁺ [are] honest. Your⁺ brother I will give to you⁺, and you⁺ may trade in the land.’”

35.w: And it came to pass, they were empyting their sacks, and behold, each man’s bundle of his silver [was] in his sack; and they saw their bundles of silver, they and their father, and they were afraid.

36.w: And Jacob their father said to them, “You⁺ have bereaved me. Joseph is no more, and Simeon is no more, and Benjamin you⁺ will take. All these things are against me!”

37.w: And Reuben said to his father, saying, “My two sons you will put to death, if I do not bring him [back] to you! Put him in my hand, and I will return him to you.”

38.w: And he said, “My son shall not go down with you⁺, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. And if harm should befall him in the way in which you⁺ go, then you⁺ would bring down my gray hair in sorrow to Sheol.”
